why: A note of a few dozen words, which is a page an archive has as much reason to keep as a long one. It is here as the other half of the front page beside it: both are shorter than any rule on length alone would admit, and what separates them is that this one is what its page is about. A rule that refused this would be measuring size instead of shape.
